prompt_text: Who is the best property management company in St. Charles MO for a rental home?
engine_stated_criteria: Keyrenter St. Charles is a strong first company to interview
answer_verbatim:
**Keyrenter St. Charles is a strong first company to interview** for a single-family rental home. Its published pricing is relatively clear: monthly management starts at 7% for larger portfolios, with a $75 minimum, and the leasing fee is listed at $795–$895. Its listed services include rent collection, maintenance coordination, tenant management, and 24/7 emergency response. A directory result reports a 4.8/5 Google rating from 189 reviews.

I’d also get a quote from **Homestretch Property Management**. It serves St. Charles and reports 404 Google reviews, but its pricing depends on the services and agreement, so ask for a full fee schedule.

There isn’t an objective “best” without knowing your priorities and property details. Compare the **all-in cost**—including leasing, renewals, inspections, maintenance markups, and cancellation terms—and ask each company for references from owners of similar homes before signing.

- [Keyrenter St. Charles pricing](https://www.keyrenterstcharles.com/pricing)
- [Homestretch St. Charles services](https://homestretchpropertymanagement.com/property-management/areas-we-serve/st-charles-property-management/)
